title: Light Croatian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and earthy Croatian lamb stew featuring cinnamon stick and pickle, made diabetic-friendly with careful ingredient selection. This quick-fix dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the cinnamon stick, sliced pickle, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the plain Greek yogurt and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
